verses.original: Ἦσαν δὲ ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ κατὰ τὴν οὖσαν ἐκκλησίαν προφῆται καὶ διδάσκαλοι ὅ τε Βαρνάβας καὶ Συμεὼν ὁ καλούμενος Νίγερ καὶ Λούκιος ὁ Κυρηναῖος Μαναήν τε Ἡρῴδου τοῦ τετραάρχου σύντροφος καὶ Σαῦλος
verses.transliteration: Ēsan de en Antiocheia kata tēn ousan ekklēsian prophētai kai didaskaloi ho te Barnabas kai Symeōn ho kaloumenos Niger kai Loukios ho Kyrēnaios Manaēn te Hērōdou tou tetraarchou syntrophos kai Saulos
verses.literal: Now in the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers - Barnabas Simeon called Niger Lucius of Cyrene Manaen ( who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch ) and Saul
verses.literalPt: Havia na igreja de Antioquia profetas e doutores: Barnabé, Simão, que tinha por sobrenome Níger, Lúcio de Cirene, Manaém, colaço de Herodes, o tetrarca, e Saulo.

verses.original: Λειτουργούντων δὲ αὐτῶν τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ νηστευόντων εἶπεν τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον Ἀφορίσατε δή μοι τὸν Βαρνάβαν καὶ Σαῦλον εἰς τὸ ἔργον ὃ προσκέκλημαι αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Leitourgountōn de autōn tō Kyriō kai nēsteuontōn eipen to Pneuma to Hagion Aphorisate dē moi ton Barnaban kai Saulon eis to ergon ho proskeklēmai autous
verses.literal: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting the Holy Spirit said Set apart for Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them
verses.literalPt: Enquanto eles ministravam perante o Senhor e jejuavam, disse-lhes o Espírito Santo: Separai-me a Barnabé e a Saulo para a obra a que os tenho chamado.

verses.original: τότε νηστεύσαντες καὶ προσευξάμενοι καὶ ἐπιθέντες τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῖς ἀπέλυσαν
verses.transliteration: tote nēsteusantes kai proseuxamenoi kai epithentes tas cheiras autois apelysan
verses.literal: And after they had fasted and prayed they laid their hands on them and sent them off
verses.literalPt: Então, depois que jejuaram, oraram, e lhes impuseram as mãos, os despediram.

verses.original: Αὐτοὶ μὲν οὖν ἐκπεμφθέντες ὑπὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος κατῆλθον εἰς Σελεύκειαν ἐκεῖθέν τε ἀπέπλευσαν εἰς Κύπρον
verses.transliteration: Autoi men oun ekpemphthentes hypo tou Hagiou Pneumatos katēlthon eis Seleukeian ekeithen te apepleusan eis Kypron
verses.literal: So . . . Barnabas and Saul sent forth by the Holy Spirit went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus
verses.literalPt: Eles, pois, enviados pelo Espírito Santo, desceram a Selêucia, e dali navegaram para Chipre,

verses.original: καὶ γενόμενοι ἐν Σαλαμῖνι κατήγγελλον τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς τῶν Ἰουδαίων εἶχον δὲ καὶ Ἰωάννην ὑπηρέτην
verses.transliteration: kai genomenoi en Salamini katēngellon ton logon tou Theou en tais synagōgais tōn Ioudaiōn eichon de kai Iōannēn hypēretēn
verses.literal: When they arrived at Salamis they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues And John was with them as their helper
verses.literalPt: e, chegados a Salamina, anunciavam a palavra de Deus nas sinagogas dos judeus; e também tinham João como ajudante.

verses.original: Διελθόντες δὲ ὅλην τὴν νῆσον ἄχρι Πάφου εὗρον ἄνδρα τινὰ μάγον ψευδοπροφήτην Ἰουδαῖον ᾧ ὄνομα Βαριησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Dielthontes de holēn tēn nēson achri Paphou heuron andra tina magon pseudoprophētēn Ioudaion hō onoma Bariēsou
verses.literal: They traveled through the whole island as far as Paphos where they found a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus
verses.literalPt: Havendo atravessado toda a ilha até Pafos, acharam um judeu chamado Barjesus, mago, falso profeta,

verses.original: ὃς ἦν σὺν τῷ ἀνθυπάτῳ Σεργίῳ Παύλῳ ἀνδρὶ συνετῷ οὗτος προσκαλεσάμενος Βαρνάβαν καὶ Σαῦλον ἐπεζήτησεν ἀκοῦσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hos ēn syn tō anthypatō Sergiō Paulō andri synetō houtos proskalesamenos Barnaban kai Saulon epezētēsen akousai ton logon tou Theou
verses.literal: an attendant of the proconsul Sergius Paulus The proconsul a man of intelligence summoned Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God
verses.literalPt: que estava com o procônsul Sérgio Paulo, varão sensato. Este, tendo chamado a Barnabé e a Saulo, mostrou desejo de ouvir a palavra de Deus.

verses.original: ἀνθίστατο δὲ αὐτοῖς Ἐλύμας ὁ μάγος οὕτως γὰρ μεθερμηνεύεται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ζητῶν διαστρέψαι τὸν ἀνθύπατον ἀπὸ τῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: anthistato de autois Elymas ho magos houtōs gar methermēneuetai to onoma autou zētōn diastrepsai ton anthypaton apo tēs pisteōs
verses.literal: But Elymas the sorcerer (for that is what his name means opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith
verses.literalPt: Mas Elimas, o mago (porque assim se interpreta o seu nome), opunha-se-lhes, procurando desviar da fé o procônsul.

verses.original: Σαῦλος δέ ὁ καὶ Παῦλος πλησθεὶς Πνεύματος Ἁγίου ἀτενίσας εἰς αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: Saulos de ho kai Paulos plēstheis Pneumatos Hagiou atenisas eis auton
verses.literal: Then Saul who was also called Paul filled with the Holy Spirit looked directly at Elymas
verses.literalPt: Mas Saulo, também chamado Paulo, cheio do Espírito de Deus, fixando nele os olhos,

verses.original: εἶπεν Ὦ πλήρης παντὸς δόλου καὶ πάσης ῥᾳδιουργίας υἱὲ διαβόλου ἐχθρὲ πάσης δικαιοσύνης οὐ παύσῃ διαστρέφων τὰς ὁδοὺς τοῦ Κυρίου τὰς εὐθείας
verses.transliteration: eipen Ō plērēs pantos dolou kai pasēs rhadiourgias huie diabolou echthre pasēs dikaiosynēs ou pausē diastrephōn tas hodous tou Kyriou tas eutheias
verses.literal: and said O child of the devil and enemy of all righteousness you are full of all kinds of deceit and trickery Will you never stop perverting the straight ways of the Lord
verses.literalPt: disse: Ó filho do Diabo, cheio de todo o engano e de toda a malícia, inimigo de toda a justiça, não cessarás tu de perverter os caminhos retos do Senhor?

verses.original: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ χεὶρ Κυρίου ἐπὶ σέ καὶ ἔσῃ τυφλὸς μὴ βλέπων τὸν ἥλιον ἄχρι καιροῦ παραχρῆμα δὲ ἔπεσεν ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἀχλὺς καὶ σκότος καὶ περιάγων ἐζήτει χειραγωγούς
verses.transliteration: kai nyn idou cheir Kyriou epi se kai esē typhlos mē blepōn ton hēlion achri kairou parachrēma de epesen ep’ auton achlys kai skotos kai periagōn ezētei cheiragōgous
verses.literal: Now look the hand of the Lord is against you and for a time you will be blind and unable to see the light of the sun Immediately mist and darkness came over him and he groped about seeking someone to lead him by the hand
verses.literalPt: Agora, eis a mão do Senhor sobre ti, e ficarás cego, não vendo o sol por algum tempo. No mesmo instante, caiu sobre ele uma névoa e trevas, e, andando à roda, procurava quem o guiasse pela mão.

verses.original: Τότε ἰδὼν ὁ ἀνθύπατος τὸ γεγονὸς ἐπίστευσεν ἐκπλησσόμενος ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: Tote idōn ho anthypatos to gegonos episteusen ekplēssomenos epi tē didachē tou Kyriou
verses.literal: When the proconsul saw what had happened he believed for he was astonished at the teaching about the Lord
verses.literalPt: Então, o procônsul, vendo o que havia acontecido, creu, maravilhando-se da doutrina do Senhor.

verses.original: Ἀναχθέντες δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς Πάφου οἱ περὶ Παῦλον ἦλθον εἰς Πέργην τῆς Παμφυλίας Ἰωάννης δὲ ἀποχωρήσας ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ὑπέστρεψεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα
verses.transliteration: Anachthentes de apo tēs Paphou hoi peri Paulon ēlthon eis Pergēn tēs Pamphylias Iōannēs de apochōrēsas ap’ autōn hypestrepsen eis Hierosolyma
verses.literal: After setting sail from Paphos Paul and his companions . . . came to Perga in Pamphylia where John left . . . them to return to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Tendo Paulo e seus companheiros navegado de Pafos, foram a Perge na Panfília; João, porém, apartando-se deles, voltou a Jerusalém.

verses.original: Αὐτοὶ δὲ διελθόντες ἀπὸ τῆς Πέργης παρεγένοντο εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν τὴν Πισιδίαν καὶ εἰσελθόντες εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων ἐκάθισαν
verses.transliteration: Autoi de dielthontes apo tēs Pergēs paregenonto eis Antiocheian tēn Pisidian kai eiselthontes eis tēn synagōgēn tē hēmera tōn sabbatōn ekathisan
verses.literal: And from Perga they traveled inland . . . to Pisidian Antioch where they entered . . . the synagogue on the Sabbath . . . and sat down
verses.literalPt: Mas eles, passando de Perge, foram a Antioquia da Pisídia e, entrando na sinagoga no dia de sábado, sentaram-se.

verses.original: μετὰ δὲ τὴν ἀνάγνωσιν τοῦ νόμου καὶ τῶν προφητῶν ἀπέστειλαν οἱ ἀρχισυνάγωγοι πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγοντες Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί εἴ τίς ἐστιν ἐν ὑμῖν λόγος παρακλήσεως πρὸς τὸν λαόν λέγετε
verses.transliteration: meta de tēn anagnōsin tou nomou kai tōn prophētōn apesteilan hoi archisynagōgoi pros autous legontes Andres adelphoi ei tis estin en hymin logos paraklēseōs pros ton laon legete
verses.literal: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets the synagogue leaders sent word to them Brothers if you have . . . . . . a word of encouragement for the people please speak
verses.literalPt: Depois da leitura da lei e dos profetas, os chefes da sinagoga mandaram-lhes dizer: Irmãos, se tendes alguma palavra de exortação ao povo, dizei-a.

verses.original: Ἀναστὰς δὲ Παῦλος καὶ κατασείσας τῇ χειρὶ εἶπεν Ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται καὶ οἱ φοβούμενοι τὸν Θεόν ἀκούσατε
verses.transliteration: Anastas de Paulos kai kataseisas tē cheiri eipen Andres Israēlitai kai hoi phoboumenoi ton Theon akousate
verses.literal: Paul stood up motioned with his hand and began to speak Men of Israel and you Gentiles who fear God listen to me
verses.literalPt: Paulo, levantando-se e acenando com a mão, disse: Israelitas e vós que temeis a Deus, ouvi:

verses.original: ὁ Θεὸς τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου Ἰσραὴλ ἐξελέξατο τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν καὶ τὸν λαὸν ὕψωσεν ἐν τῇ παροικίᾳ ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτου καὶ μετὰ βραχίονος ὑψηλοῦ ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ἐξ αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: ho Theos tou laou toutou Israēl exelexato tous pateras hēmōn kai ton laon hypsōsen en tē paroikia en gē Aigyptou kai meta brachionos hypsēlou exēgagen autous ex autēs
verses.literal: The God of the people of Israel chose our fathers He made them into a great people during their stay in Egypt and with an uplifted arm He led them out of that land
verses.literalPt: O Deus deste povo de Israel escolheu nossos pais, e exaltou a este povo no tempo em que habitou a terra do Egito, donde os tirou com braço excelso,

verses.original: καί ὡς τεσσερακονταετῆ χρόνον ἐτροποφόρησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
verses.transliteration: kai hōs tesserakontaetē chronon etropophorēsen autous en tē erēmō
verses.literal: He endured their conduct . . . for about forty years in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: e suportou-lhes os maus costumes no deserto por espaço de quase quarenta anos;

verses.original: καὶ καθελὼν ἔθνη ἑπτὰ ἐν γῇ Χανάαν κατεκληρονόμησεν τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai kathelōn ethnē hepta en gē Chanaan kateklēronomēsen tēn gēn autōn
verses.literal: And having vanquished seven nations in Canaan He gave their land to His people as an inheritance
verses.literalPt: e, havendo destruído sete nações na terra de Canaã, deu-lhes esta terra por herança durante cerca de quatrocentos e cinquenta anos.

verses.original: ὡς ἔτεσιν τετρακοσίοις καὶ πεντήκοντα Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἔδωκεν κριτὰς ἕως Σαμουὴλ τοῦ προφήτου
verses.transliteration: hōs etesin tetrakosiois kai pentēkonta Kai meta tauta edōken kritas heōs Samouēl tou prophētou
verses.literal: All this took about 450 . . . . . . years After this God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet
verses.literalPt: Depois disso, deu-lhes juízes, até o profeta Samuel.

verses.original: κἀκεῖθεν ᾐτήσαντο βασιλέα καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Θεὸς τὸν Σαοὺλ υἱὸν Κίς ἄνδρα ἐκ φυλῆς Βενιαμίν ἔτη τεσσεράκοντα
verses.transliteration: kakeithen ētēsanto basilea kai edōken autois ho Theos ton Saoul huion Kis andra ek phylēs Beniamin etē tesserakonta
verses.literal: Then the people asked for a king and God gave them Saul son of Kish from the tribe of Benjamin who ruled forty years
verses.literalPt: Em seguida, eles pediram rei, e Deus por quarenta anos lhes deu a Saul, filho de Quis, da tribo de Benjamim;

verses.original: καὶ μεταστήσας αὐτὸν ἤγειρεν τὸν Δαυὶδ αὐτοῖς εἰς βασιλέα ᾧ καὶ εἶπεν μαρτυρήσας Εὗρον Δαυὶδ τὸν τοῦ Ἰεσσαί ἄνδρα κατὰ τὴν καρδίαν μου ὃς ποιήσει πάντα τὰ θελήματά μου
verses.transliteration: kai metastēsas auton ēgeiren ton Dauid autois eis basilea hō kai eipen martyrēsas Heuron Dauid ton tou Iessai andra kata tēn kardian mou hos poiēsei panta ta thelēmata mou
verses.literal: After removing Saul He raised up David as their king and testified about him I have found David son of Jesse a man after My own heart he will carry out My will in its entirety
verses.literalPt: e, tendo deposto a este, elevou-lhes Davi como rei, ao qual também, dando testemunho, disse: Achei a Davi, filho de Jessé, homem segundo o meu coração, e ele fará todas as minhas vontades.

verses.original: Τούτου ὁ Θεὸς ἀπὸ τοῦ σπέρματος κατ’ ἐπαγγελίαν ἤγαγεν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ Σωτῆρα Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Toutou ho Theos apo tou spermatos kat’ epangelian ēgagen tō Israēl Sōtēra Iēsoun
verses.literal: From the descendants of this man God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus as He promised
verses.literalPt: Da descendência deste, conforme a promessa, trouxe Deus a Israel um Salvador, que é Jesus,

verses.original: προκηρύξαντος Ἰωάννου πρὸ προσώπου τῆς εἰσόδου αὐτοῦ βάπτισμα μετανοίας παντὶ τῷ λαῷ Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: prokēryxantos Iōannou pro prosōpou tēs eisodou autou baptisma metanoias panti tō laō Israēl
verses.literal: Before . . . the arrival of Jesus John preached a baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel
verses.literalPt: havendo João primeiro pregado, antes da vinda dele, o batismo de arrependimento a todo o povo de Israel.

verses.original: ὡς δὲ ἐπλήρου Ἰωάννης τὸν δρόμον ἔλεγεν Τί ἐμὲ ὑπονοεῖτε εἶναι οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐγώ ἀλλ’ ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται μετ’ ἐμὲ οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἄξιος τὸ ὑπόδημα τῶν ποδῶν λῦσαι
verses.transliteration: hōs de eplērou Iōannēs ton dromon elegen Ti eme hyponoeite einai ouk eimi egō all’ idou erchetai met’ eme hou ouk eimi axios to hypodēma tōn podōn lysai
verses.literal: As John was completing his course he said Who do you suppose I am I am not that One But there is One coming after me whose sandals . . . . . . I am not worthy to untie
verses.literalPt: Quando João completava a sua carreira, dizia: Eu não sou o que vós supondes; mas após mim vem aquele de cujos pés não sou digno de desatar as sandálias.

verses.original: Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί υἱοὶ γένους Ἀβραὰμ καὶ οἱ ἐν ὑμῖν φοβούμενοι τὸν Θεόν ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος τῆς σωτηρίας ταύτης ἐξαπεστάλη
verses.transliteration: Andres adelphoi huioi genous Abraam kai hoi en hymin phoboumenoi ton Theon hēmin ho logos tēs sōtērias tautēs exapestalē
verses.literal: Brothers children of Abraham . . . and - you Gentiles who fear God it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent
verses.literalPt: Irmãos, descendência de Abraão, e os que entre vós temem a Deus, a nós foi enviada a palavra dessa salvação.

verses.original: οἱ γὰρ κατοικοῦντες ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῶν τοῦτον ἀγνοήσαντες καὶ τὰς φωνὰς τῶν προφητῶν τὰς κατὰ πᾶν σάββατον ἀναγινωσκομένας κρίναντες ἐπλήρωσαν
verses.transliteration: hoi gar katoikountes en Ierousalēm kai hoi archontes autōn touton agnoēsantes kai tas phōnas tōn prophētōn tas kata pan sabbaton anaginōskomenas krinantes eplērōsan
verses.literal: The people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus yet in condemning Him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath
verses.literalPt: Pois os que habitavam em Jerusalém e os seus magistrados, não conhecendo a Jesus nem os ensinos dos profetas que se leem cada sábado, condenando-o, cumpriram as profecias;

verses.original: καὶ μηδεμίαν αἰτίαν θανάτου εὑρόντες ᾐτήσαντο Πιλᾶτον ἀναιρεθῆναι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai mēdemian aitian thanatou heurontes ētēsanto Pilaton anairethēnai auton
verses.literal: And though they found no ground for a death sentence they asked Pilate to have Him executed . . .
verses.literalPt: e, se bem que não achassem causa alguma de morte, pediram a Pilatos que o fizesse morrer.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἐτέλεσαν πάντα τὰ περὶ αὐτοῦ γεγραμμένα καθελόντες ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου ἔθηκαν εἰς μνημεῖον
verses.transliteration: Hōs de etelesan panta ta peri autou gegrammena kathelontes apo tou xylou ethēkan eis mnēmeion
verses.literal: When they had carried out all that was written about Him they took Him down from the tree and laid Him in a tomb
verses.literalPt: Quando tinham cumprido tudo o que dele estava escrito, tirando-o do madeiro, puseram-no em um túmulo.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Θεὸς ἤγειρεν αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: ho de Theos ēgeiren auton ek nekrōn
verses.literal: But God raised Him from the dead
verses.literalPt: Mas Deus o ressuscitou dentre os mortos;

verses.original: ὃς ὤφθη ἐπὶ ἡμέρας πλείους τοῖς συναναβᾶσιν αὐτῷ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ οἵτινες νῦν εἰσιν μάρτυρες αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸν λαόν
verses.transliteration: hos ōphthē epi hēmeras pleious tois synanabasin autō apo tēs Galilaias eis Ierousalēm hoitines nyn eisin martyres autou pros ton laon
verses.literal: and for many days He was seen by those who had accompanied Him from Galilee to Jerusalem They are now His witnesses to our people
verses.literalPt: e ele foi visto muitos dias por aqueles que com ele subiram da Galileia a Jerusalém, os quais agora são as suas testemunhas para com o povo.

verses.original: Καὶ ἡμεῖς ὑμᾶς εὐαγγελιζόμεθα τὴν πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας ἐπαγγελίαν γενομένην
verses.transliteration: Kai hēmeis hymas euangelizometha tēn pros tous pateras epangelian genomenēn
verses.literal: And now we proclaim to you the good news . . . What God promised . . . our fathers
verses.literalPt: Nós vos anunciamos as boas-novas da promessa feita a nossos pais,

verses.original: ὅτι ταύτην ὁ Θεὸς ἐκπεπλήρωκεν τοῖς τέκνοις αὐτῶν ἡμῶν ἀναστήσας Ἰησοῦν ὡς καὶ ἐν τῷ ψαλμῷ γέγραπται τῷ δευτέρῳ Υἱός μου εἶ σύ ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε
verses.transliteration: hoti tautēn ho Theos ekpeplērōken tois teknois autōn hēmōn anastēsas Iēsoun hōs kai en tō psalmō gegraptai tō deuterō Huios mou ei sy egō sēmeron gegennēka se
verses.literal: He has fulfilled for us their children by raising up Jesus . . . As it is written in the second Psalm You are My Son today I have become Your Father . . .
verses.literalPt: como Deus a cumpriu plenamente a nossos filhos, suscitando a Jesus, como também está escrito no Salmo segundo: Tu és meu Filho, eu, hoje, te gerei.

verses.original: Ὅτι δὲ ἀνέστησεν αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν μηκέτι μέλλοντα ὑποστρέφειν εἰς διαφθοράν οὕτως εἴρηκεν ὅτι Δώσω ὑμῖν τὰ ὅσια Δαυὶδ τὰ πιστά
verses.transliteration: Hoti de anestēsen auton ek nekrōn mēketi mellonta hypostrephein eis diaphthoran houtōs eirēken hoti Dōsō hymin ta hosia Dauid ta pista
verses.literal: In fact God raised Him from the dead never to see . . . . . . decay As He has said . . . I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David
verses.literalPt: Que o ressuscitou dentre os mortos para nunca mais tornar à corrupção, ele o disse desta maneira: Dar-vos-ei as santas e firmes coisas prometidas a Davi.

verses.original: Διότι καὶ ἐν ἑτέρῳ λέγει Οὐ δώσεις τὸν Ὅσιόν σου ἰδεῖν διαφθοράν
verses.transliteration: Dioti kai en heterō legei Ou dōseis ton Hosion sou idein diaphthoran
verses.literal: So also He says in another Psalm You will not let Your Holy One see decay
verses.literalPt: Por isso, também diz em outro Salmo: Não permitirás que o teu Santo experimente corrupção.

verses.original: Δαυὶδ μὲν γὰρ ἰδίᾳ γενεᾷ ὑπηρετήσας τῇ τοῦ Θεοῦ βουλῇ ἐκοιμήθη καὶ προσετέθη πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶδεν διαφθοράν
verses.transliteration: Dauid men gar idia genea hypēretēsas tē tou Theou boulē ekoimēthē kai prosetethē pros tous pateras autou kai eiden diaphthoran
verses.literal: For when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation he fell asleep His body was buried with his fathers and saw decay
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, tendo Davi no seu tempo servido ao conselho de Deus, adormeceu e foi reunido a seus pais e experimentou corrupção;

verses.original: ὃν δὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἤγειρεν οὐκ εἶδεν διαφθοράν
verses.transliteration: hon de ho Theos ēgeiren ouk eiden diaphthoran
verses.literal: But the One whom God raised from the dead did not see decay
verses.literalPt: porém aquele que Deus ressuscitou dentre os mortos não experimentou corrupção.

verses.original: Γνωστὸν οὖν ἔστω ὑμῖν ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί ὅτι διὰ τούτου ὑμῖν ἄφεσις ἁμαρτιῶν καταγγέλλεται
verses.transliteration: Gnōston oun estō hymin andres adelphoi hoti dia toutou hymin aphesis hamartiōn katangelletai
verses.literal: Therefore let it be known to you brothers that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you
verses.literalPt: Seja-vos, pois, notório, irmãos, que por este se vos anuncia remissão de pecados;

verses.original: καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων ὧν οὐκ ἠδυνήθητε ἐν νόμῳ Μωϋσέως δικαιωθῆναι ἐν τούτῳ πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων δικαιοῦται
verses.transliteration: kai apo pantōn hōn ouk ēdynēthēte en nomō Mōuseōs dikaiōthēnai en toutō pas ho pisteuōn dikaioutai
verses.literal: Through Him everyone who believes is justified from everything from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses
verses.literalPt: e de tudo aquilo de que não pudestes ser justificados pela Lei de Moisés, por este é justificado todo o que crê.

verses.original: βλέπετε οὖν μὴ ἐπέλθῃ τὸ εἰρημένον ἐν τοῖς προφήταις
verses.transliteration: blepete oun mē epelthē to eirēmenon en tois prophētais
verses.literal: Watch out then that what was spoken by the prophets does not happen to you
verses.literalPt: Guardai-vos, pois, de que não venha sobre vós o que foi dito nos profetas:

verses.original: Ἴδετε οἱ καταφρονηταί καὶ θαυμάσατε καὶ ἀφανίσθητε ὅτι ἔργον ἐργάζομαι ἐγὼ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ὑμῶν ἔργον ὃ οὐ μὴ πιστεύσητε ἐάν τις ἐκδιηγῆται ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Idete hoi kataphronētai kai thaumasate kai aphanisthēte hoti ergon ergazomai egō en tais hēmerais hymōn ergon ho ou mē pisteusēte ean tis ekdiēgētai hymin
verses.literal: Look you scoffers wonder and perish For I am doing a work in your days that . . . you would never believe even if someone told you
verses.literalPt: Vede, ó desprezadores, maravilhai-vos e desaparecei, porque eu faço uma obra nos vossos dias, obra que de modo algum crereis, ainda que alguém vo-la refira.

verses.original: Ἐξιόντων δὲ αὐτῶν παρεκάλουν εἰς τὸ μεταξὺ σάββατον λαληθῆναι αὐτοῖς τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Exiontōn de autōn parekaloun eis to metaxy sabbaton lalēthēnai autois ta rhēmata tauta
verses.literal: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue the people urged them to continue this message on the next Sabbath
verses.literalPt: Ao saírem eles, rogaram-lhes que no próximo sábado se lhes repetissem essas palavras.

verses.original: λυθείσης δὲ τῆς συναγωγῆς ἠκολούθησαν πολλοὶ τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ τῶν σεβομένων προσηλύτων τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ τῷ Βαρνάβᾳ οἵτινες προσλαλοῦντες αὐτοῖς ἔπειθον αὐτοὺς προσμένειν τῇ χάριτι τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: lytheisēs de tēs synagōgēs ēkolouthēsan polloi tōn Ioudaiōn kai tōn sebomenōn prosēlytōn tō Paulō kai tō Barnaba hoitines proslalountes autois epeithon autous prosmenein tē chariti tou Theou
verses.literal: After the synagogue was dismissed many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas who spoke to them and urged them to continue in the grace of God
verses.literalPt: Despedida a sinagoga, muitos judeus e prosélitos devotos seguiram a Paulo e Barnabé, e estes, falando-lhes, persuadiram-nos a perseverar na graça de Deus.

verses.original: Τῷ δὲ ἐρχομένῳ σαββάτῳ σχεδὸν πᾶσα ἡ πόλις συνήχθη ἀκοῦσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ κυρίου
verses.transliteration: Tō de erchomenō sabbatō schedon pasa hē polis synēchthē akousai ton logon tou kyriou
verses.literal: On the following Sabbath nearly the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord
verses.literalPt: No sábado seguinte, reuniu-se quase a cidade toda para ouvir a palavra de Deus.

verses.original: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τοὺς ὄχλους ἐπλήσθησαν ζήλου καὶ ἀντέλεγον τοῖς ὑπὸ Παύλου λαλουμένοις βλασφημοῦντες
verses.transliteration: idontes de hoi Ioudaioi tous ochlous eplēsthēsan zēlou kai antelegon tois hypo Paulou laloumenois blasphēmountes
verses.literal: But when the Jews saw the crowds they were filled with jealousy and they blasphemously contradicted what Paul was saying
verses.literalPt: Mas os judeus, vendo a multidão, encheram-se de inveja e, blasfemando, contradiziam o que Paulo falava.

verses.original: Παρρησιασάμενοί τε ὁ Παῦλος καὶ ὁ Βαρνάβας εἶπαν Ὑμῖν ἦν ἀναγκαῖον πρῶτον λαληθῆναι τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπειδὴ ἀπωθεῖσθε αὐτὸν καὶ οὐκ ἀξίους κρίνετε ἑαυτοὺς τῆς αἰωνίου ζωῆς ἰδοὺ στρεφόμεθα εἰς τὰ ἔθνη
verses.transliteration: Parrēsiasamenoi te ho Paulos kai ho Barnabas eipan Hymin ēn anankaion prōton lalēthēnai ton logon tou Theou epeidē apōtheisthe auton kai ouk axious krinete heautous tēs aiōniou zōēs idou strephometha eis ta ethnē
verses.literal: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly It was necessary to speak the word of God to you first But since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life we now turn to the Gentiles
verses.literalPt: Paulo e Barnabé, falando ousadamente, disseram: Era a vós que se devia falar primeiramente a palavra de Deus; mas, visto que a rejeitais e vos julgais indignos da vida eterna, eis que nos viramos para os gentios.

verses.original: οὕτως γὰρ ἐντέταλται ἡμῖν ὁ Κύριος Τέθεικά σε εἰς φῶς ἐθνῶν τοῦ εἶναί σε εἰς σωτηρίαν ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: houtōs gar entetaltai hēmin ho Kyrios Tetheika se eis phōs ethnōn tou einai se eis sōtērian heōs eschatou tēs gēs
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord has commanded us I have made you a light for the Gentiles - to bring . . . salvation to the ends of the earth
verses.literalPt: Pois assim no-lo ordenou o Senhor: Eu te tenho posto para luz dos gentios, a fim de que sejas para salvação até os confins da terra.

verses.original: Ἀκούοντα δὲ τὰ ἔθνη ἔχαιρον καὶ ἐδόξαζον τὸν λόγον τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ ἐπίστευσαν ὅσοι ἦσαν τεταγμένοι εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: Akouonta de ta ethnē echairon kai edoxazon ton logon tou Kyriou kai episteusan hosoi ēsan tetagmenoi eis zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: When the Gentiles heard this they rejoiced and glorified the word of the Lord and all who were appointed for eternal life believed
verses.literalPt: Os gentios, ouvindo isso, regozijavam-se e glorificavam a palavra do Senhor, e creram todos os que estavam destinados para a vida eterna.

verses.original: διεφέρετο δὲ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Κυρίου δι’ ὅλης τῆς χώρας
verses.transliteration: diephereto de ho logos tou Kyriou di’ holēs tēs chōras
verses.literal: And the word of the Lord spread throughout . . . that region
verses.literalPt: E divulgava-se a palavra do Senhor por toda aquela região.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ Ἰουδαῖοι παρώτρυναν τὰς σεβομένας γυναῖκας τὰς εὐσχήμονας καὶ τοὺς πρώτους τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐπήγειραν διωγμὸν ἐπὶ τὸν Παῦλον καὶ Βαρνάβαν καὶ ἐξέβαλον αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de Ioudaioi parōtrynan tas sebomenas gynaikas tas euschēmonas kai tous prōtous tēs poleōs kai epēgeiran diōgmon epi ton Paulon kai Barnaban kai exebalon autous apo tōn horiōn autōn
verses.literal: The Jews however incited the religious women of prominence and the leading men of the city They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas and drove them out . . . of their district
verses.literalPt: Mas os judeus instigaram as mulheres devotas de alta posição e os principais da cidade, e excitaram uma perseguição contra Paulo e Barnabé, e expulsaram-nos do seu território.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἐκτιναξάμενοι τὸν κονιορτὸν τῶν ποδῶν ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ἦλθον εἰς Ἰκόνιον
verses.transliteration: hoi de ektinaxamenoi ton koniorton tōn podōn ep’ autous ēlthon eis Ikonion
verses.literal: So they shook the dust off their feet in protest against them and went to Iconium
verses.literalPt: Mas, havendo estes sacudido contra aqueles o pó de seus pés, foram a Icônio,

verses.original: οἵ τε μαθηταὶ ἐπληροῦντο χαρᾶς καὶ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου
verses.transliteration: hoi te mathētai eplērounto charas kai Pneumatos Hagiou
verses.literal: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: e os discípulos estavam cheios de gozo e do Espírito Santo.
